# `core::ring` — declaration reference

Generated source inventory. Linked guides own runtime and semantic contracts; a listed declaration does not establish executable behavior.

[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../stdlib/core/ring.lani#L6)

Layer: `core`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Inline fixed-capacity ring buffer over [T; N]: O(1) push/pop at both ends, overwrite pushes that return the evicted opposite end, O(1) discard, two-run as_views and in-place make_contiguous. No allocation; an empty ring restarts at slot 0.
